metadata.rules_text:
- Model tends to overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast peaks by 5–10%.
- Underestimates mid-to-late period corrections after sharp rises; add 2–3% lagged momentum adjustment to downward corrections.
- When sentiment is flat (0.00), model exhibits persistent overconfidence; apply a 3–5% downward bias to all forecasts.
- Forecasts show mean reversion bias — overcorrect after strong moves; apply a 1–2% smoothing filter to avoid overshoots.
- If true outcome shows strong downward trend after a spike, model often fails to recognize it; adjust forecast by subtracting 3–5% of the spike magnitude from subsequent days.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts consistently overpredict early days (1–7) and underpredict late days (20–30); apply asymmetric weighting (higher weight to later days).
